problem: Of the waterfalls that are 3,000-2,300 feet tall, have an average width of 50 feet or greater, and have a confirmed status from the World Waterfall Database, which ones are located in South America?
answer: Kerepakupai Merú, Cataracta Gocta, Salto Yutajé
